scope: Incremental independent review closing V1 GPU-validity and real-light coverage gaps; original runner inverse checked again. No engine/browser execution, no repository modification.

resolved.evidence: focus_image_valid rejects null/empty image, empty payload and nonpositive/different actual root dimensions. Warmup and six fade pixel comparisons check validity and stable root size before equality. positive_changed requires a positive-strength actual image differ from valid hidden baseline. Equal empty/background images cannot satisfy the entire GPU contract.

Real PointLight2D with white ImageTexture has positive energy and screen-covering extent; explicit layer range -1..1 contains the root and both layer0 Focus/reference canvases. Independent default-lit marker OFF/ON center pixel must differ before comparing actual mask0 Focus with unchanged mask1 reference. RendererViewport selects canvas lights by this layer range (renderer_viewport.cpp:696), not only by their source canvas.

static_assessment: No definite typed GDScript/API blocker found in the added Image/PointLight2D/Vector2i logic; this does not certify parsing without native execution.

Image readback occurs after process_frame and frame_post_draw; positive-size/root-size guards prevent vacuous pixel equality. If a real display resizes mid-test the contract intentionally fails rather than silently comparing different targets.
Marker and background remain static during same-strength comparisons. Point light remains enabled for both actual and reference reads; reference keeps default mask1 and unchanged shader.

Manual _process samples only presentation output with automatic vignette processing disabled. Public ability.advance/stop drives actual active_changed/time behavior; original subsequent Router/Controller tests supply real input coverage.

Normal and synchronous parent destruction are measured by actual weak references to observed SubViewport nodes; candidate-specific nonzero creation assertion prevents GPU lifecycle vacuity. Observer disconnect occurs before host.free, and lambda retains only WeakRef array.
Fixture light/image/material resources are local or child-owned; no persistent registry was added. Strict exit/leak behavior is still a runtime gate.
Headless execution skips all GPU reads/light fixture and explicitly records unverified_headless; passing ordinary headless wrapper cannot substitute for GPU pixel/variant validation.
limitations: This fixture does not measure shader cache reuse, first-shot/AIM performance, startup cost or browser behavior.
Global frame_post_draw is not a per-viewport completion receipt; observed rendering/cleanup outcomes still require the actual run.
All inherited V2/V3 production evidence remains separate; no failed baseline or V1 review is overwritten.
